symptom: Semantic error: Invalid node type: REQUIREMENT.
workaround: add **Type**: SECTION to the heading that has prose but no type marker; no line number is reported so bisect by heading

symptom: TraceabilityIndex: the document imports a grammar from a file that does not exist: spec.sgra
workaround: omit the Grammar field in _assets/*.md; it resolves relative to the document own folder and ../spec.sgra is rejected too

symptom: Semantic error: Markdown parsing error: duplicate field names in a valid requirement node are not allowed.
workaround: not only blank lines or --- rules: a second **Relations**: block inside one requirement triggers it too. happens when an edit inserts a full node body before the existing Relations block. no line number is reported, so grep for repeated field names within a node
